description: Returns citable reference snippets on a topic, formatted for RAG insertion with stable IDs and a source for each. Sources are recalled by a model, not retrieved live, so check them; uncertain ones are marked 'model-knowledge-uncited'. Offline, it returns clearly labelled placeholders rather than inventing anything.
